title: TBK Vision Extraction Output v1
description: The two-channel extraction contract from docs/AI/VisionExtractionContract.md section 3. Channel one (observations) carries facts the model could name in taxonomy terms; channel two (unmatched) carries facts it saw but could not place. Neither is optional. Provenance fields mirror ai.eal.models.Provenance exactly - this is not a second provenance scheme.

image_id.description: TBK_IMAGE_ID - sha256 content hash of the image bytes (ai/vision/python/pipeline.py). Set by the pipeline, not by the model.

group.description: Attribute Group name from the taxonomy digest

value.description: Any JSON type, or null. MUST be null unless value_state is 'present'.

value_state.description: ai.eal.models.ValueState. 'null' = does not apply; 'unknown' = applies but undetermined. Collapsing these loses the distinction the pipeline exists to preserve.

confidence.description: MUST be null when value_state is not 'present' - there is nothing to be confident about. Enforced by EALAttributeRecordModel._value_state_consistency downstream.

evidence.description: The model's own words for why. Never paraphrased downstream.

unmatched.description: The capability that does not exist in either implementation today. An empty array is a valid result; a missing key is not.

why_unmatched.description: Required. The difference between a usable proposal and a stray string.

unparsed.description: Model output that became neither an observation nor an unmatched item. Retained rather than dropped - the only signal that makes prompt regression visible.
